name: has_data
definition: n_fy_usable >= 4 (four filed years = one 3-year growth rate)

name: arun_strict
definition: sales_g3>20 & profit_g3>20 & roe_avg3>15 & roce>15 (lenders: ROE only) & de<=0.2 & mcap_pit>1000cr & no negatives

name: opm_slope_pos
definition: strict AND 3-year annual OPM slope >= 0 (margins not falling)

name: opm_steady
definition: strict AND 3-year annual OPM range <= 5pp (margins stable)

name: opm_rising_q
definition: strict AND 8-quarter OPM slope > 0 - RECENT WINDOW ONLY (~mid-2023 on): Screener carries ~13 quarters, so this is NaN and therefore False before that

name: opm_min
definition: strict AND minimum annual OPM over 3 years >= 10pp
